scope: Verified practical home-community handoffs only. Local access points, regional intake, destination care, travel and return-home supports remain distinct.

notes: Existing provincial intake, NIHB, medical-travel and regional parent programs were not duplicated.

Structural inequality and accountability findings are excluded from this public practical-resource dataset.
